name: OpenZeppelin
rootCause: OpenZeppelin released a bug fix analysis. Whitehat Zb3 submitted a serious reentrant vulnerability in OpenZeppelin's TimelockController contract on August 21, 2021, which affected a project hosted on the Immunefi vulnerability bounty platform. The project chose to remain anonymous and has paid an undisclosed amount (including an anonymous bonus) to White Hat. OpenZeppelin paid White Hat a bonus of $25,000 to recognize their contribution to community security and released a patch. As far as it knows, this is the only serious vulnerability that OpenZeppelin has in its open source smart contract library. The vulnerability has been patched in the affected…
